```{r tables-setup}
# 稿件表格汇总 / Assemble manuscript tables.
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("SEED_PROJECT_ROOT", unset = getwd()), winslash = "/"), "R", "config.R"))
source(file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "R", "io.R"))
```

```{r tables-s1}
# Table S1 为人工整理输入 / Table S1 is a manually curated input.
file.copy(file.path(DATA_DIR, "manual", "Table S1.xlsx"),
          file.path(TAB_DIR, "Table S1.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r tables-s2-s3}
# Table S2/S3 由数据集章节生成 / Generated by the dataset chapter.
assert_files(file.path(TAB_DIR, c("Table S2.xlsx", "Table S3.xlsx")), "Table S2/S3")
```

```{r tables-s4}
# Table S4 由宿主系统发育章节生成 / Generated by the host-phylogeny chapter.
assert_files(file.path(TAB_DIR, "Table S4.xlsx"), "Table S4")
```

```{r tables-s5}
# Table S5：GOS 分类表 / GOS classification tables.
cl16 <- data.table::fread(file.path(TAB_DIR, "gos", "gos_classified_16s.txt"))
clit <- data.table::fread(file.path(TAB_DIR, "gos", "gos_classified_its.txt"))
writexl::write_xlsx(list(Table_S5A = as.data.frame(cl16), Table_S5B = as.data.frame(clit)),
                    file.path(TAB_DIR, "Table S5.xlsx"))
```

```{r tables-s6}
# Table S6：16S ASV 分类、宿主分布与功能性状 / 16S ASV trait profile.
traits <- data.table::fread(file.path(TAB_DIR, "TableS6_taxonomy_16s_traits.tsv"))
writexl::write_xlsx(list(taxonomy_16s_traits = as.data.frame(traits)),
                    file.path(TAB_DIR, "Table S6.xlsx"))
```

```{r tables-s7}
# Curated prediction-coverage workbook added during revision.
file.copy(file.path(DATA_DIR, "manual", "Table S7.xlsx"),
          file.path(TAB_DIR, "Table S7.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r tables-check}
# 表格完整性检查 / Check all seven workbooks.
expected <- file.path(TAB_DIR, paste0("Table S", 1:7, ".xlsx"))
assert_files(expected, "manuscript table")
for (f in expected) message(basename(f), " ", round(file.info(f)$size / 1024), " KB")
```
